about.description: We're a licensed and insured roofing, construction, and restoration company built on one operating standard across two divisions. Based in Dallas, Texas, we serve the entire DFW Metroplex — from planned construction improvements to urgent 24/7 emergency restoration. One accountable team owns the next step.

image.alt: Palafox roofing, construction, and restoration crew

description: Palafox was founded on a simple but powerful idea: property owners shouldn't have to choose between a company that builds and a company that restores. Whether you're planning a construction project or facing an urgent emergency, you deserve the same accountability, the same discipline, and the same standard of work — every single time. That's why we built Palafox with two divisions under one roof and one operating standard that never changes.

Our Construction Group handles planned improvements with precision — documented scopes, clear timelines, protected sites, and direct communication from first call to final walkthrough. Our Restoration division responds without delay when disaster strikes, mobilizing field teams 24/7 to protect your property and get you back to normal fast. Two divisions. One accountable team. One standard.

Today, Palafox proudly serves the entire DFW Metroplex — Dallas, Trophy Club, Keller, and surrounding communities. With over 1,200 projects delivered, a 4.9 Google rating, and 15+ years in the field, we've earned a reputation for doing things right the first time. Licensed and insured. Workmanship backed. Ready when you are. Put the right team on your property.

image.alt: Palafox leadership team and field crew

howWeWork.headline: A Controlled Process. Every Time.
howWeWork.description: Whether you are building or restoring, every Palafox project follows the same disciplined four-step process — so you always know what happens, when it happens, and who owns it.

steps.title: Assess

steps.subtitle: Timeline & Specification

steps.title: Execute
steps.subtitle: Disciplined Site Fieldwork
steps.description: Certified crew deployment, strict Texas safety compliance, continuous debris management, and complete property protection.

steps.title: Verify
steps.subtitle: Final Walkthrough & Warranty

section.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Straight answers about our roofing, construction, and 24/7 emergency restoration services across the DFW Metroplex.

items.question: Do you offer 24/7 emergency response?
items.answer: Yes. Our Restoration division responds 24/7 across the DFW Metroplex. Call (817) 232-3866 anytime — day or night — and we'll mobilize without unnecessary delay.

items.question: What roofing services do you offer?
items.answer: We handle residential and commercial roofing — new installations, repairs, and replacements. Precision workmanship built to endure Texas weather, backed by 15+ years in the field.

items.question: What does your Construction Group do?
items.answer: Our Construction Group handles planned property improvements with documented scopes, clear timelines, and direct communication from first call to final walkthrough.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve the entire DFW Metroplex — Dallas, Trophy Club, Keller, and surrounding communities across the Dallas-Fort Worth area.

items.question: How does your process work?
items.answer: Every project follows the same controlled process: Assess, Plan, Execute, Verify. On-site evaluation, documented scope, disciplined fieldwork, and a final walkthrough before we close the job.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Palafox is fully licensed and insured. Your property and your investment are protected on every project, across both divisions.

items.question: How fast can you respond to an emergency?
items.answer: Our field teams mobilize without unnecessary delay. Call (817) 232-3866 any time — 24/7 emergency response across the DFW Metroplex.

items.question: Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?
items.answer: Yes. Palafox serves both residential and commercial property owners across the DFW Metroplex — roofing, construction, and restoration under one standard.

items.question: Do you offer free estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide free, no-obligation estimates on every project. Call (817) 232-3866 or start your request online to schedule.

items.question: Will I have one point of contact?
items.answer: Yes. From first call to final walkthrough, you'll have one point of contact. One accountable team owns the next step — no runaround, no confusion.
